own.reason: Fix is FluxGenerate slow-path request accounting (emitted counter not reset, hang with competing requests). No finding touches FluxGenerate: F0 is UnicastManySinkNoBackpressure NPE, F1 DirectProcessor late-subscriber terminal, F2/F3 Operators.MonoSubscriber discard races. Different code throughout.

Fix is FluxUsingWhen/MonoUsingWhen early-cancel races (leak / fails to cancel, arbiter + closure-subscriber states). No finding touches UsingWhen: F0/F1 are UnicastManySink races, F2 MonoSubscriber double-discard, F3/F4 FluxSubscribeOnCallable run-vs-cancel. Different code throughout.

Fix is FluxPublishOn delivering onError for a RejectedExecutionException when onNext races cancel. No finding touches FluxPublishOn: F0 is SinkManyUnicast NPE, F1 MonoSubscriber double-discard, F2 SinkManyEmitterProcessor swallowed error (different class from FluxPublishOn despite both involving errors). Different code throughout.

Fix is FluxReplay cancel-vs-subscribe ordering with refCount (stale connection replays onto new subscriber). No finding touches FluxReplay: F0 ConcatMapDelayed drain wakeup, F1 TakeFuseable double terminal, F2 BufferTimeout drift. Different code throughout.

Fix is the FluxSwitchOnFirst race-safety rewrite (single volatile state machine; cancel not triggering expected inbound onError). No finding touches FluxSwitchOnFirst: F0/F1 are UnicastManySink NPEs, F2 SinkManyBestEffort TERMINATED overwrite. Different code throughout. No open fix matches either (none touches the sink classes).

Fix is FluxFlatMap innerError marking inner.done before updating ERROR, so a parallel inner onComplete triggers downstream onComplete and drops errors. No finding touches FluxFlatMap/merge: F0 is MonoMetricsFuseable swallowing terminal errors (different operator, different mechanism), F1 StreamCollector cancel-discard, F2 BufferPredicate poll-vs-cancel. Different code throughout. No open fix matches either.

Fix is MonoCollect/MonoCollectList cancel holding synchronized while calling upstream.cancel (deadlock). No finding touches MonoCollect(List): F0 is TakeFuseable double terminal, F1 Operators.MonoSubscriber double-discard (different class and mechanism from the MonoCollect deadlock), F2 BufferPredicate poll-vs-cancel. Different code throughout. No open fix matches either.

open.reason: Same operator (FluxPublishOn.PublishOnSubscriber) and same racing pair (onNext vs cancel), but different effect/mechanism: the fix drops a RejectedExecutionException-derived onError when already cancelled, while F1 claims one queued element is discard-handled twice. Same code region, different faulty behaviour.

own.reason: Fix is MonoDelayElement run-vs-onNext race (task state CAS loops for CANCELLED/TERMINATED). No finding touches MonoDelayElement: F0 is the unicast-sink subscribe-vs-emit NPE, F1 publishOn double-discard, F2/F3 MonoSubscriber discard races. Different code throughout.
